\documentclass[paper={a5paper},maintitle={Melody Replay Test}]{ulsbs-songbook}
\makeatletter
\newcount\ULtestbeatdraws
\let\ULtestoriginalbeatdraw\UL@melodybeatdraw
\def\UL@melodybeatdraw{%
  \ifshowbeats\ifdefined\@beatsdisabled\else
    \global\advance\ULtestbeatdraws by 1\relax
  \fi\fi
  \ULtestoriginalbeatdraw
}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\begin{songs}{}
\beginsong{Melody Replay}
  \newchords{melodyreplay}
  \memorize[melodyreplay]
  \beginverse
    \[<C>]note-only \[G]chord \[<D>]note-only \[Am]chord
  \endverse
  \replay[melodyreplay]
  \beginverse
    \[^<E>]note-only \[^]chord \[^<F>]note-only \[^]chord
  \endverse
  \newchords{melodyexclude}
  \mnbeginverse\memorize[melodyexclude]
    \[<!C*>G]stored one \[^<D*>Am]excluded \[<E*>C]stored two
  \mnendverse
  \ExplSyntaxOn
  \tl_set:No \l_tmpa_tl {\the\cs:w SB@cr@melodyexclude\cs_end:}
  \typeout{ULSBS-REGISTER-BEGIN:\tl_to_str:V \l_tmpa_tl :ULSBS-REGISTER-END}
  \ExplSyntaxOff
  \global\ULtestbeatdraws=0
  \notesoff
  \beginverse\replay[melodyexclude]
    stored one ^then stored two ^done
  \endverse
  \typeout{ULSBS-REPLAY-BEAT-DRAWS:\the\ULtestbeatdraws}
  \global\ULtestbeatdraws=0
  \beatsoff
  \beginverse\replay[melodyexclude]
    hidden beat one ^then hidden beat two ^done
  \endverse
  \typeout{ULSBS-HIDDEN-BEAT-DRAWS:\the\ULtestbeatdraws}
  \beatson
  \noteson
\endsong
\end{songs}
\end{document}
